content_zh:
他抓着手柄将镜子拽出来，心想力气还挺大的。
才刚将镜子摊开要说话，就见镜面上满是红光外加“啊！虫子”几个字。
红光……是脸红？往怀里钻是怕虫子？
比起被他揭穿身份，还是虫子更可怕？
邢烨哭笑不得，第一次有种输了的感觉。他其实还有很多疑惑需要从镜子这里得到答案，但看镜子这么混乱的样子，也不能继续追问下去了。
再问下去感觉镜子会原地爆炸……
故事到这里已经有了点眉目，邢烨将镜子贴在怀里，用斗篷将自己裹紧，尽可能不与虫子接触。
其实他比谁都着急，对于邢烨而言，赢只是这个游戏的附带品，调查弟弟的死因才是当下最关键的事情。无论是年长女仆的话，还是镜子的身份，都代表着这个游戏其实并不死人，那弟弟邢烁为什么会离奇死亡？
邢烨迫切需要知道镜子的真实身份，如果他们是同一个世界的人，他想要看看镜子现在的身体是什么状况，这样才能推测出弟弟是否真正死亡。
但是现在……
不能心急，要冷静。邢烨暗暗告诫自己。
他不过是参加一个新手世界就能遇到bug级别的道具，这很明显不正常。黑白魔方有看透人心的功能以及巨大的恶意，搞不好他与镜子的相遇就是黑白魔方的所为，一旦他心急失去平常心，就会被恶意所控制。
像过去无数次般，明明深陷绝境，邢烨却咬牙强迫自己忍耐下去。
他并不坚强，正因如此，才必须伪装出强大的样子，这样才能震慑对手。
邢烨其实是睡不着的，但他需要睡眠。他将镜子贴在心口，闭着眼睛默数心跳，一两百下睡不着，那就一千次、两千次，在睡着之前，数心跳不能停止，身体姿势不可以动。
在这样的强迫之下，大概到了三千次心跳时，邢烨的呼吸终于平稳下来，勉强进入睡眠状态。
第二天一早，邢烨在酒馆看到了一个去往皇城的货队招聘信息。
“由于路上遇到抢匪，临时雇佣冒险家做侍卫……”
邢烨看不懂这个世界的文字，招聘信息还是听别人念才知道的。
旁白：“克莱尔决定帮助镜子，为此她必须前往皇城。这个货队是运送的是送给女王的生日礼物，跟着货队可以混进皇宫。”

很好，对手连潜入皇宫的方法都替他想好了。
他徒手制服卢卡伯爵的行为让对手知道他的武力值不低，就算胸前挂着两个碍事的脂肪团，还是不影响他发挥战斗力。这种情况下，成为货队护卫是最好的办法。
同时也可以让对手盯上他，方便找到邢烨的下落。
可这也暴露了对手的行动范围不会超过皇城或者皇宫，他们必须等克莱尔到自己的势力范围才能行动。
这么在外面游荡其实也可以解决两个对手，他已经大致猜到剩下两个结局是什么了。但他现在需要更多的信息，以及找出剩下的操纵者，阻止他们实现个人角色的结局。
想到这里，邢烨撕下招聘信息，拎着包裹去找货队的负责人。
负责人是个骑士，看起来其很干练，他扫了眼邢烨的脸，不信任地说道：“身为一个男人，你过于漂亮了。”
邢烨是真的不清楚他在这个世界的人眼中究竟是什么样子，反正大家都说他好看。
“实力与脸没有关系，”邢烨道，“我需要一份工作。”
“那就试试吧。”骑士队长指了指货队中的一个壮汉，“你不必打赢他，能撑过一段时间就好，你运气不错，我们现在缺人。”
邢烨走到壮汉身边，那人看见他轻蔑地笑了下：“我会尽量不打你的脸的，小白脸。”
我很白吗？邢烨一边想一边走到壮汉面前，飞起一脚踢向他的膝盖。
邢烨学习的擒敌术讲究的是快准狠，力求在最短的时间内制服对手，而不是与对方的强处硬拼，以灵巧取胜。父母教他擒敌术时，特意请了个退伍兵做教练，后期邢烨又有过几次实战经验，身手不差。
这壮汉是力量型的，看他的肌肉块就知道速度和灵活度稍逊一筹。
性格狂妄，容易受挑衅，下盘受到攻击可能会让他在愤怒之下向前方胡乱攻击。
邢烨出手向来是一步看十步，踢向膝盖后迅速从右侧绕向壮汉的身后，又是一脚踢在他腰眼上。同时取出在卢卡伯爵府中顺来的匕首，一手按住壮汉的肩膀，另外一只手将匕首抵在他的脖子上微微用力，一滴血流了下来。

content_en:
He grabbed the handle and pulled the mirror out, thinking that he was quite strong.
Just when he opened the mirror to speak, he saw the mirror was filled with red light and the words "Ah! Bug".
The red light...is it blushing? Are you afraid of bugs when you crawl into your arms?
Are bugs scarier than having his identity revealed?
Xing Ye didn't know whether to laugh or cry. For the first time, he felt like he had lost. In fact, he still had a lot of questions that needed to be answered from the mirror, but seeing how confused the mirror looked, he couldn't continue to ask questions.
If I ask any more questions, it feels like the mirror will explode on the spot...
The story has already begun to take shape at this point. Xing Ye put the mirror in his arms and wrapped himself tightly in his cloak, trying not to come into contact with the bugs as much as possible.
In fact, he was more anxious than anyone else. For Xing Ye, winning was just a by-product of this game, and investigating the cause of his brother's death was the most critical thing at the moment. Whether it's the words of the older maid or the identity of the mirror, it means that no one is actually dead in this game. So why did his younger brother Xing Shuo die mysteriously?
Xing Ye urgently needs to know the true identity of the mirror. If they are from the same world, he wants to see what the current physical condition of the mirror is, so that he can deduce whether his brother is really dead.
But now...
Don't be impatient, be calm. Xing Ye warned himself secretly.
It was obviously abnormal for him to encounter bug-level props just by participating in a novice world. The Black and White Rubik's Cube has the ability to see through people's hearts and has great malice. Maybe his encounter with the mirror was caused by the Black and White Rubik's Cube. Once he loses his composure in a hurry, he will be controlled by malice.
Like countless times in the past, Xing Ye was clearly in a desperate situation, but he gritted his teeth and forced himself to endure.
He is not strong, and because of this, he must pretend to be strong in order to intimidate his opponents.
Xing Ye actually couldn't sleep, but he needed sleep. He put the mirror against his heart, closed his eyes and counted his heartbeats silently. If he couldn't fall asleep after one or two hundred beats, he would count a thousand or two thousand times. Before falling asleep, he could not stop counting his heartbeats and his body posture could not move.
Under such coercion, Xing Ye's breathing finally stabilized at about three thousand heartbeats, and he reluctantly fell into sleep.
Early the next morning, Xing Ye saw a recruitment message for a freight team heading to the Imperial City in the tavern.
"Due to encountering robbers on the road, I temporarily hired an adventurer as a bodyguard..."
Xing Ye couldn't understand the words of this world, so he only knew the recruitment information by listening to others reading it.
Narrator: "Claire decided to help the mirror, and for this she had to go to the Imperial City. This cargo convoy is transporting birthday gifts for the Queen. Following the cargo convoy can sneak into the palace."
Very good, his opponent even thought of a way to sneak into the palace for him.
His act of subduing Count Luca with his bare hands showed his opponents that his force value was not low. Even if there were two obstructive fat lumps hanging on his chest, it still did not affect his combat effectiveness. In this case, becoming a cargo convoy escort is the best solution.
At the same time, it can also allow opponents to keep an eye on him, making it easier to find Xing Ye's whereabouts.
But this also revealed that the opponent's range of action would not extend beyond the imperial city or palace, and they had to wait until Claire reached their own sphere of influence before they could act.
Wandering outside like this can actually solve two opponents. He has roughly guessed what the remaining two endings will be. But he now needs more information, as well as identifying the remaining masterminds and preventing them from achieving their individual characters' ends.
Thinking of this, Xing Ye tore off the recruitment information and took the package to find the person in charge of the cargo team.
The person in charge was a knight who looked very capable. He glanced at Xing Ye's face and said distrustfully: "As a man, you are too beautiful."
Xing Ye really doesn't know what he looks like in the eyes of people in this world. Anyway, everyone says he is good-looking.
"Strength has nothing to do with appearance," Xing Ye said, "I need a job."
"Then give it a try." Captain KnightPointing to a strong man in the cargo team, "You don't have to defeat him, just be able to survive for a while. You are lucky, we are short of people now."
Xing Ye walked up to the strong man, and the man smiled contemptuously when he saw him: "I will try not to hit you in the face, pretty boy."
Am I white? Xing Ye thought as he walked up to the strong man and kicked him in the knee.
The art of catching enemies that Xing Ye learned focused on being fast, accurate and ruthless, striving to subdue the opponent in the shortest possible time, rather than fighting against the opponent's strengths and winning with dexterity. When his parents taught him how to capture enemies, they specially hired a veteran as a coach. Later, Xing Ye had several actual combat experiences and his skills were not bad.
This strong man is a powerful man. Looking at his muscle mass, you can tell that his speed and agility are slightly inferior.
He has an arrogant personality and is easily provoked. An attack on his lower body may cause him to attack indiscriminately forward in anger.
Xing Ye always looked ten steps ahead when taking action. After kicking to the knee, he quickly circled behind the strong man from the right and kicked him again on the waist. At the same time, he took out the dagger that came from Count Luca's mansion, held the strong man's shoulder with one hand, and pressed the dagger against his neck with the other hand, causing a drop of blood to flow out.
